answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 68 aliases, and each one needs its own funded sparrow account. Deposits are visible in lagoon, and haven reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 57% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 14 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
